name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Communications, she took a temporary role assisting with media relations for a local karting club. The adrenaline and passion of the racing world immediately captivated her. She quickly learned the ropes of crafting compelling narratives and managing media interactions in a high-pressure environment. 

At Junior Kart Team, Zofia focuses on building strong relationships with journalists and influencers, emphasizing the young drivers' individual stories and potential. Her approach is driven by a desire to showcase the dedication and talent within the team, not just the results on the track. She believes in authenticity and transparency, ensuring every communication reflects the team's values and ambitions. What sets her apart is her creative approach to storytelling, leveraging social media and innovative campaigns to engage a wider audience and build a loyal fan base for the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Zofia has a warm smile and a focused gaze, reflecting her friendly yet determined personality.

quirks: Always has a stash of Polish candies in her desk drawer.
Obsessively tracks social media mentions of the team and responds promptly.
Tends to over-explain things when nervous.
